# rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles (Data Source)

Discovers the IAM operator roles that exist in the AWS account for a ROSA Seaplane V2 (HCP) operator-roles prefix, with their ARNs, attached AWS-managed policies, tags, and applied definition version. Useful for importing an existing role set (e.g. one created by the rosa CLI) into a `rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles` resource.

The data source talks directly to AWS IAM using the provider's ambient AWS credentials; it does not call the Platform API or OCM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Discover an existing V2 operator role set (e.g. one created by the rosa
# CLI) for import into a rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles resource:
#
#   terraform import rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles.roles my-cluster
data "rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles" "roles" {
  operator_roles_prefix = "my-cluster"
}

output "role_arns" {
  value = { for role in data.rhcs_seaplane_operator_roles.roles.roles : role.suffix => role.arn }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `operator_roles_prefix` (String) Prefix used to discover the operator roles (roles are named `<prefix>-<suffix>`).

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) AWS account ID hosting the operator roles.
- `definition_version` (String) Definition-version tag found on the discovered roles (empty when the roles predate version tagging).
- `id` (String) The operator roles prefix.
- `instance_profile_name` (String) Name of the worker node EC2 instance profile (empty when no worker role is found).
- `partition` (String) AWS partition the roles live in (`aws`, `aws-cn`, or `aws-us-gov`).
- `roles` (Attributes List) The discovered operator roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `arn` (String) IAM role ARN.
- `is_worker_role` (Boolean) True for the worker node instance role (EC2 trust).
- `managed_policy_arns` (List of String) AWS-managed policy ARNs attached to the role.
- `name` (String) Full IAM role name (`<prefix>-<suffix>`).
- `service_accounts` (List of String) OIDC trust subjects declared by the definition set for this role.
- `suffix` (String) Role name suffix (the part after the prefix).
- `trust_policy` (String) The role's assume-role (trust) policy document.
